units.source_text: 且说源氏大将躲在壁橱里，看见那扇门没有关紧，留着一条细缝。

en.t: Now General Genji was hiding in a wall cupboard, and he saw that the door had not been shut tight, leaving a narrow crack.

units.source_text: 他便把门推开，悄悄地钻出来，沿着屏风背后，走到了藤壶皇后的居室中。

en.t: He pushed the door open, slipped out quietly, and made his way behind the screens into Empress Fujitsubo's chamber.

units.source_text: 他久已不见皇后的姿态，如今窥见了，悲喜交集，竟流下泪来。

en.t: He had not seen the Empress's figure for a long time, and now, catching a glimpse of her, he was overcome with both sorrow and joy and began to weep.

units.source_text: 但见她脸向着外方，娇声地说：“我现在还很难过，看来活不下去了！”

en.t: He saw her turn her face outward and say in a delicate voice, "I still feel so wretched now; it seems I cannot go on living."

units.source_text: 那侧影之优美，不可言喻。

en.t: The beauty of that profile was beyond words.

units.source_text: 侍女们拿些水果来劝她吃，盛在一个形似盒盖的盘子里，式样非常雅观。

en.t: The ladies-in-waiting brought some fruit and urged her to eat, serving it on a tray shaped like the lid of a box, very elegant in design.

units.source_text: 但藤壶皇后看也不看一眼。

en.t: But Empress Fujitsubo would not even look at it.

units.source_text: 她只管悲叹尘世之艰辛，悄悄地耽入沉思，那样子实在可怜。

en.t: She only lamented the hardships of this world and quietly sank into brooding thought, a sight that was truly pitiful.

units.source_text: 源氏大将想道：“她那头容秀美，发光艳丽，长长地披散下来，竟和西殿里那个人完全一样。

en.t: General Genji thought, "Her lovely face, and her shining, lustrous hair falling long around her, are exactly like those of the lady in the western wing.

units.source_text: 年来我有了那个人，对她的恋慕之心稍稍忘怀。

en.t: Over these years, because I have had that lady, I have somewhat forgotten my longing for her.

units.source_text: 现在一看，二人果然肖似之极。”

en.t: Now that I look, the two are indeed astonishingly alike."

units.source_text: 他确信紫姬可以略慰他对藤壶的相思。

en.t: He became convinced that Lady Murasaki could somewhat console him for his longing for Fujitsubo.

units.source_text: 又想：“气度之高雅与神色之矜持，两人也完全一样。

en.t: He thought again, "In the elegance of their bearing and the reserve of their expression, the two are completely the same as well.

units.source_text: 然而，或许是心情所使然吧，我这个自昔倾心恋慕的人儿，更富有盛年的娇艳。”

en.t: And yet, perhaps it is only my feelings, but this person whom I have loved with all my heart since long ago has even more of the radiant beauty of her prime."

units.source_text: 想到这里，感奋之极，竟顾不得前后，悄悄地钻进帐中，拉住了藤壶皇后的衣裾。

en.t: Thinking this, he was so stirred that he lost all caution, slipped quietly inside the curtains, and took hold of Empress Fujitsubo's hem.
